description.value: Parkgate Community Centre is a publicly operated recreation facility run by the North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission (NVRC) in the eastern reaches of North Vancouver, near the Deep Cove area and popular North Shore cycling routes. The centre houses a large gymnasium with badminton, pickleball, basketball, and volleyball courts, a climbing wall, a fitness centre, a pottery studio, and several bookable meeting and multi-purpose rooms. As a community hub near trailheads and scenic coastal roads, it could serve as a practical rest or regrouping point for touring cyclists passing through the area.
